verdict.rationale: Unit documents APIs for accounts with real-time balances and for payments, but these are general developer building blocks. The evidence never mentions scoped credentials for agents, transfer amount caps, counterparty allowlists, or any vendor-named agent use case. The card 'configurable controls' feature covers cards, not account transfers, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate an account within policy — scoped credentials that let it read balances and initiate transfers under amount caps and counterparty allowlists, a use the vendor documents by name
